verdict.rationale: Superset's core documented purpose is running many coding agents concurrently, each in an isolated Git worktree and branch. It provides a dashboard for monitoring many concurrent sessions and fan-out orchestration across worktrees. A community power user independently reports running 40-50 agent sessions across several repos simultaneously without issues.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run many agent tasks concurrently to scale delivery throughput

citations.quote: Run several coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or any CLI agent) at the same time on one repository without them stepping on each other. Each agent gets an isolated Git worktree and its own branch.
Review diffs, manage ports, and monitor many concurrent agent sessions from one dashboard.
Fan out a refactor or migration across several worktrees at once
Now i'm running probably 40-50 agent sessions over several repos simultaneously without any issues and losing track!
